mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.paragraph1: NextGen Women Hoops is a U20 female basketball platform dedicated to discovering, developing, and elevating young talents to professional stages.
mission.paragraph2: We build a fair, professional, and international environment where female athletes compete, grow, and receive deserving recognition.
mission.paragraph3: Beyond organizing tournaments, NextGen Women Hoops aims for a youth basketball ecosystem connecting athletes, clubs, scouts, and fans, while inspiring the next generation of female athletes to confidently pursue basketball.

brandStory.heading: Our Vision & Mission
brandStory.body: Our vision is a future where women's basketball is celebrated, supported, and given the same stage as any other sport. NextGen Women Hoops exists to make that vision real — creating a pathway for U20 athletes to develop their skills, build lasting connections, and inspire the next generation of players and fans.

tournamentSystem.heading: Tournament System
tournamentSystem.body: Every tournament we run follows recognized technical and officiating standards, giving players, coaches, and fans confidence in fair, professional competition. Specific certifications and partnerships will be detailed here as they're confirmed.
